topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I can't shake the image of the words, how they looked so familiar, like I saw them somewhere before. The professor's eyes were stern, drilling into me, and I felt the walls of the room pressing in. I should have double-checked, should have read more, written more from my own thoughts. Now, I'm here, explaining, stumbling over words that don’t feel like my own. I want to fix this, to show them who I am, not what they’re thinking now. I wish I had the courage to face this head-on, to prove that I can do better, be better. For now, I just nod, agreeing to their terms, to make it right.
